title: Tenant-bound Ownership
intent: Revalidate tenant and owner relationships at every protected operation.
problem: Without repository predicates include tenant and owner identifiers, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the tenant-bound ownership contract.
context: This pattern addresses shared storage serves independent organizations; its concrete control is repository predicates include tenant and owner identifiers.
forces: Correctness requires that cross-tenant rows are never returned
Operational pressure can cause: an ID-only lookup leaks another tenant
solution: Implement repository predicates include tenant and owner identifiers. Verify the anchored symbol `NotFound` with `test_memory_repository_contract` before reuse.
invariants: ownership is checked from durable state, not request claims
failure_modes: an ID-only lookup leaks another tenant
ownership changes between read and write
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `an ID-only lookup leaks another tenant` and fails closed if the tenant-bound ownership evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For tenant-bound ownership, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to repository predicates include tenant and owner identifiers.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: shared storage serves independent organizations
Do not apply when: data is physically isolated with no shared query surface
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
not_when: data is physically isolated with no shared query surface
